description: This file contains the implementation of AdminServerContainer, a Java class that manages an administrative server socket used for inter-process communication within the OFBiz framework. It handles commands like status inquiries and shutdown requests, provides server lifecycle management (init, start, stop), and processes client requests over a network socket.

classes.name: AdminServerContainer
classes.description: A final class implementing the Container interface, responsible for starting and managing an administrative server socket that listens for commands like shutdown and status within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: OfbizSocketCommand
classes.description: An enum defining socket commands: SHUTDOWN, STATUS, and FAIL, used for communication between the admin client and server.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the AdminServerContainer by creating a server socket on the configured address and port, and setting up the server thread.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server thread to begin listening for incoming connections.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Interrupts the server thread to stop listening for connections.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the container instance.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Private method that runs in a loop accepting client connections and processing requests.

methods.name: processClientRequest
methods.description: Handles communication with a connected client, reading the command, determining the response, and executing shutdown if requested.

methods.name: determineClientCommand
methods.description: Parses the client request string and determines the corresponding command enum.

methods.name: isValidRequest
methods.description: Validates whether the incoming request string has the correct format and key.

methods.name: prepareResponseToClient
methods.description: Prepares the response string based on the command received and current server state.
